verdicts.reason: A is mostly the original scaled down rather than rearranged: the product circle is cropped at the top and bottom edges, the subline 'New botanical sparkling, out now.' is too small to read at 320x50, and the NEW pill and Try It button are tiny. Still, it keeps the left-to-right order, the brand colours and a clear headline. B rearranges the layout but badly: the NEW badge collides with the product circle and the Try It button overlaps it, the product shrinks to a cramped icon, the CTA lands mid-banner ahead of the supporting copy so the reading order is broken, and the subline is crammed into a 3-line ragged block against the right edge.
